events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, opened its gates on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, a field in New York became the epicentre of a cultural revolution. The Woodstock Festival. Three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. What's your favourite memory or track from the era?

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley, a true icon who redefined music and performance, left us on this day in 1977. His legacy continues to inspire. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon on this day in 1970. His innovative guitar work continues to resonate through generations of music. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969 in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road iconic album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your favourite moment from their final recorded album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, a true rock icon. Still delivering those incredible tunes. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod and changed the game forever. Remember meticulously curating your playlists and carrying thousands of songs in your pocket? What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrated globally, James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since Dr. No premiered, launching a cinematic legend. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate 007 theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today. A true visionary whose music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese birthday fun
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us countless comedic masterpieces. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album deep dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed every facet of their genius. What are your standout tracks from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
